```python
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError

# Define the RoomCreate model
class RoomCreate(BaseModel):
    name: str
    capacity: int

# Define the Room model
class Room(BaseModel):
    id: int
    name: str
    capacity: int

# Define the BookingCreate model
class BookingCreate(BaseModel):
    room_id: int
    title: str
    start: datetime
    end: datetime

# Define the Booking model
class Booking(BaseModel):
    id: int
    room_id: int
    title: str
    start: datetime
    end: datetime

# Define the NotFoundError and ConflictError exceptions
class NotFoundError(Exception):
    pass

class ConflictError(Exception):
    pass

# Define the Storage class
class Storage:
    def __init__(self, db_path: str):
        # Initialize the storage with the database path
        pass

    def create_room(self, data: RoomCreate) -> Room:
        # Create a new room in the database
        pass

    def get_room(self, room_id: int) -> Room:
        # Retrieve a room from the database
        pass

    def list_rooms(self) -> List[Room]:
        # List all rooms in the database
        pass

    def create_booking(self, data: BookingCreate) -> Booking:
        # Create a new booking in the database
        pass

    def list_bookings(self, room_id: int) -> List[Booking]:
        # List all bookings for a specific room in the database
        pass

    def delete_booking(self, booking_id: int) -> None:
        # Delete a booking from the database
        pass

# Define the create_app function
def create_app(db_path: str) -> FastAPI:
    # Create a FastAPI application
    app = FastAPI()
    # Add the Storage instance to the application
    app.storage = Storage(db_path)
    return app

# Define the test_client function
def test_client(create_app):
    # Create a test client for the FastAPI application
    client = TestClient(create_app(":memory:"))
    return client

# Define the test_health function
def test_health(client):
    # Test the health endpoint
    response = client.get("/health")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == {"status": "ok"}

# Define the test_room_create function
def test_room_create(client):
    # Test creating a room
    data = RoomCreate(name="Test Room", capacity=2)
    response = client.post("/rooms", json=data.dict())
    assert response.status_code == 201
    assert response.json() == {"id": 1, "name": "Test Room", "capacity": 2}

# Define the test_room_create_duplicate_name function
def test_room_create_duplicate_name(client):
    # Test creating a room with a duplicate name
    data = RoomCreate(name="Test Room", capacity=2)
    response = client.post("/rooms", json=data.dict())
    assert response.status_code == 409
    assert response.json() == {"detail": "Room name already exists"}

# Define the test_room_create_invalid_body function
def test_room_create_invalid_body(client):
    # Test creating a room with an invalid body
    data = RoomCreate(name="Test Room", capacity=-1)
    response = client.post("/rooms", json=data.dict())
    assert response.status_code == 422
    assert response.json() == {"detail": "Capacity must be greater than or equal to 1"}

# Define the test_room_list function
def test_room_list(client):
    # Test listing all rooms
    response = client.get("/rooms")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == [{"id": 1, "name": "Test Room", "capacity": 2}]

# Define the test_room_create_booking function
def test_room_create_booking(client):
    # Test creating a booking
    data = BookingCreate(room_id=1, title="Test Booking", start=datetime.now(), end=datetime.now() + datetime.timedelta(hours=1))
    response = client.post("/bookings", json=data.dict())
    assert response.status_code == 201
    assert response.json() == {"id": 1, "room_id": 1, "title": "Test Booking", "start": "2023-04-01T12:00:00", "end": "2023-04-01T13:00:00"}
